entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • EF Core 10 generates invalid down migration for MSSQL nvarchar(max) to json upgrade #38364
  • Allow providers to replace the many-to-many (skip-navigation) loader #38363
  • Inconsistency between C# Nullable Reference Types (NRT) and EF Core LINQ Expression Trees for optional columns #38362

Closed

  • Support ORDER BY in SQLite aggregate functions #32201
    11.0.0
  • Add Cosmos support for complex types #31253
    11.0.0
  • Migration tries to alter column type of computed column if CLR type changes. #33425
    11.0.0
  • Wrong comment for parameter of `UseCompatibilityLevel` #38347
    11.0.0
  • JSON deserialize explicitly sets property values when they are not included in the JSON #38354
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite throws InvalidOperationException when unpackaged #38275
    11.0.0
  • Feature Request: Support SQL Server RECOMPILE Hint for Raw SQL and Stored Procedure Execution #38338

PullRequests

Created

  • Support "unconstrained" foreign key relationships (#13146) #38361
    community-contribution
  • Add support for JSON, composite, include and exclude Cosmos indexes #38360

Merged

  • Translate string.Join/Concat with ordering on SQLite #38344
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38365
  • Skip ALTER COLUMN for computed columns when only CLR type changes #38252
    community-contribution
  • Add wildcard (*) support to GetMigrations, ScriptMigration, and DropDatabase #38327
    community-contribution
  • Fix wrong XML doc comment for UseCompatibilityLevel parameter #38359
  • Catch InvalidOperationException for unpackaged WinUI3 apps in SqliteConnection #38304

Updated

  • [release/11.0-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38366
  • EF1003: Detect explicit string.Format/string.Concat in raw SQL APIs #38208
    community-contribution
  • Improve relational model integration in Query #38346
